issues.detail: The Greek 'ου προσανεθεμην' (ou prosanethemen) is a perfect passive participle meaning 'not having been joined' or 'not being joined.' The Vietnamese 'lập tức tôi chẳng tham khảo' translates to 'immediately I do not consult,' which changes the grammatical structure and the core meaning of the relationship between the speaker and the flesh/blood.
